newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil - pressure builds on LS.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil - pressure builds on LS.

text.p: Low sulphur straight-run fuel oil remained range bound on Thursday amid a lack of buying interest.

Prices were put unchanged in the mid $120s fob NWE with a first week in October paper trade at $127 and $126 offered on the wet side. Sellers were reluctant to let go material which they saw as historically cheap against crude, but there has been a build up in unwanted product despite recent U.S. demand which threatens to overhang the market for some time. High sulphur straight run fortunes were mixed. Plentiful M-100 was being forced into the cracked market while E-4 has managed to retain some exclusivity with prices around formula +$2-3.
